intro: Generate an official Training Record (SSI progress log) for each student, signature included — nothing you fill in here is saved to the cloud, it's only downloaded.
sinPlantillas: There are no templates ready to use yet.

instructorMissing.mensaje: Before generating, complete your instructor details (name, initials, SSI Pro number and signature) in your profile.

roster.hint: Each student only adds their name, initials and signature — everything else is already set up above.
roster.vacio: You haven't added any student yet.
roster.faltanDatos: This student is missing some data
roster.noSePudoExportarImagen: Couldn't export the image. Please try again.
roster.noSePudoCompartir: Couldn't share the document. Please try again.

studentForm.hint: Just what changes from one student to the next — the course and its dates were already set once for the whole list.
studentForm.inicialesHint: Calculated automatically — you can correct them if needed.

confirmarCambioPlantilla.mensaje: You'll lose the progress, dates and signatures you've already filled in for this student.

studentSheet.configCompartidaHint: This is filled in ONCE for the whole class. Each student only adds their name, initials and signature, further down in "Students".
studentSheet.progresoHint: Check off what's already done — grey rows are required to certify the course.
studentSheet.faltanCampos: Some required fields are missing — check the messages in red.
studentSheet.sinAlumnos: Add at least one student before generating.
